question: list pelanggan aktif yg perusahaannya bergerak di Teknologi atau Finansial (dari nama perusahaan), urut per company
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active' AND (c.company LIKE '%Teknologi%' OR c.company LIKE '%Finansial%') ORDER BY c.company

question: Hitung jumlah aktivitas, total durasi, dan rata-rata durasi untuk tipe call dalam 7 hari terakhir.
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_menit, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_menit FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'call' AND a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 7)

question: Tampilkan deal won bernilai di atas 400.000 yang ditutup kuartal ini, urut nilai turun.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.value > 400000 AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today()) ORDER BY d.value DESC

question: Berapa banyak sales rep yang namanya berakhiran 'Kusuma' dan tidak berada di tim Inbound?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_sales FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.name LIKE '%Kusuma' AND r.team != 'Inbound'

question: Ringkasan pelanggan baru bulan ini: berapa total pelanggannya, berapa perusahaan berbeda, dan kapan pendaftaran pertama serta terakhirnya?
sql: SELECT count() AS total_pelanggan_baru, uniqExact(c.company) AS jumlah_perusahaan, min(c.created_at) AS daftar_pertama, max(c.created_at) AS daftar_terakhir FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfMonth(today())

question: Cari deal pipeline yang belum di-update lebih dari 60 hari padahal probabilitasnya di atas 80.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.probability > 80 AND d.updated_at < subtractDays(now(), 60)

question: Tampilkan tiket urgent yang diselesaikan dalam waktu kurang dari 4 jam selama 90 hari terakhir.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.resolution_time_hours < 4 AND t.created_at >= subtractDays(now(), 90)

question: Tampilkan nilai deal dalam satuan ribuan (dibulatkan 2 desimal) untuk 15 deal proposal terbaru.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.created_date, round(d.value / 1000, 2) AS nilai_ribu FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'proposal' ORDER BY d.created_date DESC LIMIT 15

question: Hitung durasi aktivitas dalam jam untuk meeting hari ini, urut dari yang paling lama.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, round(a.duration_minutes / 60, 2) AS durasi_jam FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'meeting' AND toDate(a.timestamp) = today() ORDER BY a.duration_minutes DESC

question: brp total nilai pipeline yg probabilitasnya 50 ke atas tp nilainya di bawah 100rb?
sql: SELECT sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.probability >= 50 AND d.value < 100000

question: Tampilkan pelanggan Enterprise yang terdaftar tahun lalu (bukan tahun ini).
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND c.created_at < toStartOfYear(today())

question: Ada berapa tiket yang sedang dikerjakan (in_progress) untuk prioritas selain low, dibuat bulan ini?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'in_progress' AND t.priority != 'low' AND t.created_at >= toStartOfMonth(today())

question: Tampilkan aktivitas email yang durasinya di bawah 5 menit atau lebih dari 60 menit.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'email' AND (a.duration_minutes < 5 OR a.duration_minutes > 60)

question: Hitung berapa hari sejak setiap tiket terbuka urgent dibuat, urutkan dari yang paling lama menunggu.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, dateDiff('day', t.created_at, now()) AS umur_hari FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress') ORDER BY umur_hari DESC

question: List pelanggan yang datanya di-update dalam 7 hari terakhir tapi daftarnya sudah lebih dari 1 tahun.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.updated_at >= subtractDays(now(), 7) AND c.created_at < subtractDays(now(), 365)

question: Tampilkan deal New yang lost dengan nilai di atas 200.000, dari nilai terbesar, maksimal 20 baris.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost' AND d.title LIKE 'New%' AND d.value > 200000 ORDER BY d.value DESC LIMIT 20

question: Berapa omset kuartal ini dan berapa jumlah deal won-nya?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_deal_won, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today())

question: Cari pelanggan blacklisted atau churned yang perusahaannya bukan PT (misal CV), urutkan per status lalu nama.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status IN ('blacklisted','churned') AND c.company NOT LIKE 'PT %' ORDER BY c.status, c.name

question: Aktivitas paling baru dari sales R10 apa?
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp FROM activities AS a WHERE a.rep_id = 'R10' ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

question: Hitung jumlah deal pipeline yang tahapnya proposal atau negotiation dengan nilai minimal 50.000 dan dibuat dalam 60 hari terakhir.
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('proposal','negotiation') AND d.value >= 50000 AND d.created_date >= subtractDays(now(), 60)

question: Rekap tiket terbuka yang dibuat tahun ini: jumlah tiket, jumlah pelanggan yang terdampak, dan tanggal tiket tertua.
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_tiket, uniqExact(t.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan, min(t.created_at) AS tiket_tertua FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') AND t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today())

question: Tampilkan 10 pelanggan churn yang paling lama tidak di-update.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, c.updated_at FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned' ORDER BY c.updated_at ASC LIMIT 10

question: Berapa rata-rata durasi aktivitas yang bukan email dan bukan support_ticket selama kuartal ini?
sql: SELECT round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_durasi FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type NOT IN ('email','support_ticket') AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfQuarter(today())

question: Tampilkan deal won yang ditutup dalam 7 hari terakhir dengan nilai antara 50.000 dan 150.000, urutkan tanggal tutup terbaru.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= subtractDays(now(), 7) AND d.value BETWEEN 50000 AND 150000 ORDER BY d.closed_date DESC

question: list sales yg region-nya bukan APAC, urutkan per tim lalu nama
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, r.region FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.region != 'APAC' ORDER BY r.team, r.name

question: Berapa jumlah pelanggan berbeda yang membuat tiket urgent dalam 30 hari terakhir?
sql: SELECT uniqExact(t.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.created_at >= subtractDays(now(), 30)

question: Tampilkan deal yang ditutup (won atau lost) bulan ini beserta lama siklusnya dalam hari.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date) AS lama_hari FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())

question: Siapa 3 pelanggan aktif segmen Enterprise yang paling baru bergabung?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, c.created_at FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 3
